name: Francesca Moraca
bioAdditions: Francesca married Bruno Ferlaino on 3 November 1777 (S1). The marriage names her parents as Domenico Moraca and Domenica Mendicino, both new to the tree. She was the mother of both Nicola Maria (1778) and Vincenzo (1781) Ferlaino, so she is John's ancestor through two lines.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Tree data match an indexed San Mango parish entry (derivative index of a primary register; image online but not read by me).
